note: Which parts of Ostrel Rhea can walk into. Regions in 'open' are open from the start; any other region opens when the story sets the flag open.<region>. 'routes' are road journeys the story needs: the road tiles between those places stay walkable even where they cross a closed region. 'why' is what Rhea is told when she walks up to a closed border.

why.guild: Guild checkpoints ring Vantry. Without indenture papers, Rhea would be taken at the first one.
why.crown: Crown foresters patrol the royal parks. Anyone without a pass is turned back, or worse.
why.corvane: League toll-men hold the hill roads. Nobody without a Corvane letter gets past the toll houses.
why.hollin: The Free Towns have shut their gates to strangers from the north since the raids.
why.college: The College lets in patients and physicians. Rhea is neither, yet.
why.drevka: Drevka clan riders watch the high grazing. Strangers who come uninvited don't come back down.
why.ember: Between here and the Ember Courts is a week of desert. Nobody crosses it without water, a guide and a reason.
why.tarsis: Tarsis sells swords to whoever pays. Walking up to their walls unannounced is how you get sold too.
why.ashby: The coast road to Port Ashby is watched by smugglers who don't like new faces.
why.lorne: The road north to Lorne is closed until the snow lifts from the passes.
why.high-passes: Snow chokes the passes. Nobody gets through until the thaw.
why.cloud-forest: The cloud forest is thick with mist and wild kith. Without a guide, Rhea would never find her way out.
why.fens: The fens are flooded. The causeways are under water.
why.deep-desert: Nobody walks into the deep desert without water and a guide.
why.storm-roost: Lightning walks the slopes of the Storm Roost. Not today.
why.low-water: The canal stair is locked and chained.
why.osk: The shoals are under deep water. The tide won't drop for a long time yet.
why.salt-house: The salt marshes are a maze of sucking mud. Rhea would need someone who knows the way.
why.wandering-herd: The eastern plateau is bare and endless. Rhea has no reason to go there yet.
